phase: Phase C6 - lunar albedo + thermal-IR radiation pressure: effect-size survey on the real LRO arc (2009-260..263)
written: 2026-11-01, before any C6 code or number
motivation: F2p estimates K_SRP = 0.0745 m^2/kg against a physical prior of 0.010 +- 0.005 (FDF LRO operations: cannonball 14 m^2, Cr 1.0-1.67, Slojkowski et al. ISSFD 2014 Table 1) and F3b found the sigma* gain is partly a K / S_T re-split. Lunar radiation pressure is absent from the F2 force model. At 50 km the dayside thermal IR flux is of order the solar flux (sigma T^4 with T ~ 380 K is ~1.2 kW/m^2) and points radially outward, so a cannonball K could be absorbing it. FDF did not model it ('assumed quite small', Slojkowski 2014 sec. 6.2); the TU Delft LRO study (Stiller and Dirkx 2023, poster) found lunar RP dominated by the thermal part and affecting secular a and omega. This survey measures, linearly and without new long fits, whether adding it moves K toward the physical value and improves the 263 prediction.

model.moon: uniform sphere, R = lunar_od.srp R_MOON_M; the cap visible from the spacecraft is discretised in spacecraft-nadir polar coordinates, N_theta = 60 rings (midpoint in theta from 0 to acos(R/r)) x N_phi = 72 azimuths, dA = R^2 sin(theta) dtheta dphi
model.albedo: Lambertian, constant Bond albedo a = 0.12; radiance L = a S(d) cos(psi) / pi where psi = solar zenith angle of the element (0 contribution for cos psi <= 0) and S(d) = c * lunar_od.srp.solar_pressure_at(d)
model.thermal: Lambertian emission, emissivity 0.95; T = max(T_ss cos(psi)^(1/4), T_night) with T_ss = ((1 - a) S(d) / (0.95 sigma))^(1/4) (radiative equilibrium) and T_night = 100 K; radiance L = 0.95 sigma T^4 / pi
model.target: cannonball with the SRP convention a = K_LRP * sum_i L_i cos(e_i) dA_i / (c d_i^2) * u_i, u_i the unit vector from the element to the spacecraft, e_i the emission angle; no self-shadowing, no occultation besides the Moon itself (by construction of the cap)
model.sun: SPICE spkpos SUN wrt MOON, J2000, NONE, at et0 + t (same kernels F2 loads)
model.k_lrp_nominal: 0.010 m^2/kg = F2H_PRIORS' physical K_SRP prior mean (the same cannonball)
model.frame_and_epoch: J2000 Moon-centred; F3's cached reference (lro_data/f3_cache/reference.npz, F2p's parameters, 20 s grid, t from F2p's et0)

linear_method.sensitivity: S_lrp(t) = Phi(t) * integral_{t_epoch}^{t} Phi(tau)^-1 [0; a_lrp(tau)] dtau, trapezoid on F3's 20 s reference grid, Phi from the cached history (column-major hist[:, 6:42]); at K_LRP = 1 m^2/kg (unit column)
linear_method.rows: the LRP column of each measurement row is hx(t_row) @ S_lrp(t_row) with F3's local rows hx (unit-weight, Doppler scaled as in F3)
linear_method.batch: linearised batch about F2p (= F3's sigma = 0 smoother), fit rows only, F3's prior(z) on the 15 F2p parameters (epoch 10 km / 10 m/s, Doppler bias 1 m/s, F2H priors); solved with phase_f3_core.batch_oracle; 263 rows predicted with the solved deviation

experiments.E0: no LRP (must reproduce F3's sigma = 0 263 chi2)
experiments.E1: LRP fixed at K_LRP = 0.010 (residuals shifted by the nominal column), 15 parameters re-solved
experiments.E2: LRP scale estimated as a 16th parameter with no prior (unit column scaled to K_LRP = 0.010)
experiments.E1b: as E1 with albedo 0.19 (DLAM-1 mean used by Stiller and Dirkx 2023), reported only

scores: fit-day and 263 range RMS (m) and Doppler RMS (mm/s); 263 chi2 = sum of squared unit-weight 263 residuals (F3's definition); share = (chi2_E0 - chi2_X) / (chi2_E0 - 3642.61), 3642.61 = F3 sigma* (c15d5c8); solved K_SRP, C_T, S_T and formal sigma; E2 scale and its correlation with K; acceleration statistics along the arc (RMS and max of |a_lrp|, RIC split, ratio to |a_srp| at K = 0.010)

gates.G_UNIT: unit tests pass: (a) uniform-temperature sphere, flux = sigma T^4 (R/r)^2 radial, to 1e-3 relative at 50 km altitude and at r = 10 R; (b) zero-phase Lambert albedo far field (2/3) a S (R/r)^2 to 1e-2 at r = 20 R; (c) spacecraft over the subsolar point: non-radial part <= 1e-6 of the magnitude
gates.G_QUAD: the same quadrature applied to the SRP acceleration (srp_acceleration_kernel, K = 1) and to the C_T empirical acceleration reproduces the cached K and C_T sensitivity columns: max position difference over the fit arc <= 1e-3 of the column's max position norm
gates.G_E0: E0 reproduces F3's sigma = 0 263 chi2 69 899.79 to 1e-6 relative
gates.G_SIZE: max position norm of the nominal LRP column (K_LRP = 0.010) over 260-263 <= 200 m (inside the range F3b's G_LIN verified linear: 0.049 m error on a 169 m offset)

hypotheses.H_K: E1 lowers the solved K_SRP by >= 0.03 m^2/kg (about half of F2p's 0.0645 excess over the prior mean)
hypotheses.H_SCALE: E2 scale is > 3 sigma from 0 and within 3 sigma of 1

decision_rule: any gate FAIL -> C6_NOT_QUALIFIED. Otherwise H_K or H_PRED -> C6_LRP_MATERIAL; neither -> C6_LRP_IMMATERIAL
reading_rule: C6_LRP_MATERIAL -> C6-I: lunar radiation pressure as a study-level force term in F2's propagation and a nonlinear refit (own predeclaration). C6_LRP_IMMATERIAL -> the K excess is not lunar radiation; next candidate box-wing / panel SRP. H_SCALE is reported with the decision and read with its correlation to K
limitations_stated_in_advance: linear (first order about F2p); uniform albedo; analytic temperature model, not Diviner maps; cannonball target (LRO's solar array tracks the Sun, so the true response to a nadir source differs; Stiller and Dirkx found opposite along/cross signs between cannonball and paneled targets); spacecraft thermal re-radiation not modelled

amendments_before_any_survey_number.A1: theta quadrature: Gauss-Legendre in x with theta = theta_max x^2 instead of the midpoint rule; the midpoint rule with 60 rings missed G_UNIT (a) at 50 km altitude by 1.7e-3 (the integrand peaks under the nadir). Model, gates and thresholds unchanged
amendments_before_any_survey_number.A2: G_UNIT (b) evaluated at r = 500 R instead of 20 R: (2/3) a S (R/r)^2 is the far-field limit and at 20 R the model is 3.7 % above it through O(R/r) finite-distance terms (part of the limb is hidden, elements are not at zero phase), not through quadrature error

amendment_A3_after_run1.what_happened: Run 1 (results/phase_c6_lunar_radiation_survey_run1_quadrature.json) FAILED G_QUAD as computed: the quadrature reproduced the cached K column to 1.4 % and the C_T column to 7.2 % (max over the fit arc), so run 1 is C6_NOT_QUALIFIED and its experiment numbers are not read.
amendment_A3_after_run1.diagnosis: the quadrature multiplies F3's finite-difference Phi(t) by Phi(tau)^-1; cond(Phi) grows to 8.5e11 by the arc end and the product loses accuracy after about a day (C_T column error 1e-5 at 6 h, 9e-3 at 1.4 d, 0.36 at 2.3 d; local 20 s transitions Phi(t+20)Phi(t)^-1 depart from symplectic by 0.6-0.8 after day 1). Orientation verified (transposed Phi gives 100 % error)
amendment_A3_after_run1.change: columns are computed by integrating d/dt X = A(t) X + [0; F(t)] from X(t_epoch) = 0 along F3's cached trajectory (RK4, 10 sub-steps per 20 s interval, cubic Hermite states, linear forcing), A from the full gravity gradient (Moon point mass + GL1800F N = 300 in MOON_PA_DE440 at et0 + t + Earth and Sun third body); SRP and empirical gradients omitted (negligible). Integrator unit-tested against the closed-form oscillator (tests/test_phase_c6_lunar_radiation.py)
amendment_A3_after_run1.unchanged: model, experiments, gates and thresholds; G_QUAD is re-evaluated with the new column method on the same cached K and C_T columns
amendment_A3_after_run1.consequence_outside_C6: F3's transition() forms local transitions from the same FD Phi; this affects the sigma > 0 DMC runs of F3/F3b (not F3c, which is plain batch). To be assessed in its own step

amendment_A4_after_run2.what_happened: Run 2 (A3 method; results/..._run2_interp_forcing.json): G_QUAD C_T PASS (8.5e-4) but K FAIL (2.4e-3 > 1e-3) -> C6_NOT_QUALIFIED as computed; experiment numbers recorded, not read
amendment_A4_after_run2.diagnosis: the SRP forcing switches on and off at shadow entry/exit inside the 20 s intervals and run 2 interpolated all forcings linearly between grid nodes, which smears each transition
amendment_A4_after_run2.change: all four forcings (SRP kernel K = 1, C_T, LRP nominal, LRP albedo 0.19) are evaluated exactly at every RK4 sub-step node (positions and velocities from the cubic Hermite spline of the cached states; Sun interpolated linearly); gradients cached in lro_data/f3_cache/c6_gradients.npy
